## 1. Exact screening (exploratory; exact clean law; 100,000 prefixes per physics, master 8101)

B_exact = E_true(naive) − E_true(exact composition with q_assumed): positive means accounting for the channel with the (wrong) assumed prior still beats ignoring it. Paired prefix-level 95% intervals. Predicted-safe = location prior correct and (β_a ≤ β_t or odds(β_a) ≤ 2 odds(β_t)); there exact composition must not lose to naive on any record.
